issues.description: getCategoryLabel replaces explicit label map with heuristics, regressing known labels with no tests
issues.detail: The old CATEGORY_LABELS map stated facts ('trustboundaries' -> 'Trust Boundaries'); the new four-rule heuristic (special cases, version regex, <=3 char acronym, default capitalize) silently regresses to 'Trustboundaries' and will mislabel future short words like 'web' as 'WEB'. Restore the explicit data map or land a table-driven unit test for every known category id.

issues.description: SEVERITY_ORDER silently aliases 'Info' to 'Informational' with no comment or normalization
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 creates a dual-vocabulary in a shared constants file with no commit message, comment, or test. Either the API emits both spellings (normalize at the boundary) or the alias is dead. Pick one canonical key and document the invariant.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the per-row map, making render O(n^2)
issues.detail: Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) runs inside the row .map() callback, recomputing a loop-invariant aggregate per row. calculatedWidth and displayPercentage also duplicate fallback logic with different denominators (max vs total). Hoist maxValue and total above the loop and extract a helper returning {widthPct, labelPct}.

issues.description: PR bundles Risk Radar feature with unrelated rename, findings filter, and bar-chart refactor
issues.detail: Risk Radar, a global 'Threat Score' -> 'Prowler ThreatScore' rename, a findings-page category filter, and a bar-chart math refactor are braided into one commit. Future bisects and reverts cannot separate concerns. Split into at least three patches so each change has one reason to exist.

issues.description: SPECIAL_CASES dictionary ships empty as speculative abstraction
issues.detail: SPECIAL_CASES is an empty Record with a 'add entries here if needed' comment. That is the speculative-fourth-driver pattern. Delete it; add the dictionary when a real second example arrives, shaped by an actual case rather than a guess.

issues.description: Active filter badge entry for 'category__in' deleted while category filter is added
issues.detail: DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES loses its category entry in the same PR that adds a category filter to the findings page. If badges drive the 'X Categories filtered' chip, active category filters will silently render without a badge. Confirm intentional or restore the entry.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The Risk Radar feature itself is fine, but it arrived stapled to a global rename, a findings-page filter, and a bar-chart refactor — and the category-label adapter swapped an explicit data map for a four-rule heuristic that silently regresses 'Trust Boundaries' to 'Trustboundaries' with no tests. Constants gained a quiet Info/Informational alias, the bar chart recomputes a loop-invariant max per row, and an empty SPECIAL_CASES dictionary ships as speculative abstraction. Split the patches, restore the label map (or add a test table), and either normalize severity strings at the edge or document the alias.
